purpose: end-to-end read-only preview: point, structured delta, display sentence, provenance and gaps on one screen

stateSource.checkpoint: used when it matches its digest and replay is unavailable
stateSource.replay: production replay_state, preferred; a missing checkpoint is not an unrecoverable state
stateSource.reportedSeparately: checkpoint digest comparison and replay verification are separate fields

realHistory.note: every committed delta is an empty object, so only point-scoped no-change sentences appear

boundaries.case: predecessor lacks the entity or the field
boundaries.evidence: the production apply_point rejects a delta on an unknown entity (KernelViolation id_unresolved), and characters always carry sanity and position

boundaries.handling: listed as not displayed, flagged notAChange, never rendered as a quiet point

boundaries.case: same predecessor splitting into two branches
boundaries.evidence: world_points has UNIQUE(world_id,previous_point_id) where previous_point_id is not null, so one point has one successor

boundaries.handling: gap state not recoverable with the replay error attached, no sentence and no guessed origin
